messages:
tara: Heads-up — running a short sync at 11am to finalize an ‘arena claim’ one-pager for next week’s webinar and SDR handoff. Need crisp claims vs hyperscalers, vs LLM APIs, and vs infra vendors. 1-2 claims + evidence each, please.

mohit: I can take the tech side. Draft claim vs hyperscalers: ‘Predictable latency at scale via smart routing + continuous batching.’ Backup: p95 <200ms on our standard chat workload (internal benchmark). Evidence link: https://redwood.internal/bench/2026/latency-1

elaine: Nice. Marketing needs each claim as: one-line headline (10 words), one-sentence backup, and one evidence bullet (metric/link/customer quote). I’ll make the one-pager layout / visuals.

sam_kt: For SDR routing, propose tag map so leads hit the right play: e.g. tag -> routing queue. Quick mapping below:
```
needs-sla -> Enterprise SDR
ops-burden -> Solutions Engineer
cost-sensitive -> PLG Growth SDR
prototype -> Developer Success
```
This way we can route webinar signups and benchmark downloads automatically.

mohit: Also a claim vs LLM API vendors: ‘Unified rollout + graceful fallback keeps product online during model regressions.’ Backup: A/B rollouts + model-variant fallback reduced error-induced 5xx by 98% in staging. Will attach a config snippet showing fallback priority.

elaine: Can you make those two claims snappy? Example headline option for fallback: ‘Rollouts that don’t break your app.’ For hyperscaler headline: ‘Consistent latency, not surprise stalls.’ I’ll test tone in 3 variants.

ana_bot: Reminder: webinar landing page content freeze is tomorrow 9:00 AM PT. :warning: Please surface assets to #martech by EOD.

tara: Action items: Mohit — add two metric bullets + short config snippet for fallbacks; Sam — wire routing tags into Marketo/HubSpot and draft quick SDR copy; Elaine — finalize one-pager and 3 headline variants. Everyone — two supporting evidence items (metric/link or quote).

mohit: Done — added benchmark doc and config snippet to the shared drive: https://redwood.internal/docs/arena-claims-2026 (will post excerpt to the deck). Also adding a short log excerpt showing p95 calcs.

sam_kt: Draft SDR script for routing: ‘Hi {{name}}, saw you checked the benchmark — are you evaluating SLA predictability or trying to reduce ops overhead? If SLA -> invite to enterprise workshop; if ops -> intro to SE.’ Will post in #sales-playbooks.

elaine: I’ll assemble the one-pager with the three headline variants and send a mock to this thread for quick sign-off by 4pm. Prefer punchy language + one visual: claim vs competitor grid.

mohit: One more technical pointer vs infra vendors: claim = ‘Lower ops lift via managed KV/caching + autoscaling tuned for inference.’ Backup: customer X reduced SRE hours by ~30% after switching to our Dedicated config. Need permission to use anonymized quote.

tara: Great. If legal sign-off needed for the quote, loop in legal now. Otherwise, we’ll assume anonymized stat. :thumbsup:

ana_bot: FYI — webinar ops scheduled 3pm Wed. Speaker roster confirmed.

elaine: Mock sent (link): https://redwood.internal/mocks/arena-onepager-v1 — feedback welcome, especially on the competitor grid wording.

sam_kt: Review complete, minor copy tweak on SDR CTA. I’ll push to Marketo after Elaine finalizes.

tara: Perfect — thanks everyone. Quick check tomorrow AM here and we’ll lock visuals + landing.

mohit: 👍 will polish evidence bullets tonight and post final snippets.

elaine: Thanks — aiming for 2pm review tomorrow.

sam_kt: On it.

ana_bot: Thread pinned to #marketing for the sync notes.
